review.rationale: Primary review of all 47 Thayer School of Engineering faculty listed under the 'Electrical / Computer' program area (Thayer has no departments; the program area is its official ECE designation), reconciled with a full-roster independent Haiku audit that also checked the 39 untagged faculty. 36 professors are included; teaching-track, adjunct, visiting and emeritus entries are excluded. Limit: faculty without a program-area tag are not assessed beyond that check.
review.independent_review_scope: Full-roster independent audit of 47 directory entries.
